effects.notes: On your turn you may pay 1 grain to the general supply to use the action space your right neighbor used on their just-ended turn (neighbor-restriction predicate and frequency limits flagged in unresolved).

unresolved_fields: effects.0.predicate: restricting the reusable space to the one the right neighbor just used has no established predicate (A130 reuse_second_person_space is unrestricted)
effects.0.frequency_limit: how often the reuse may happen (per placement, once per turn, once per round) is not stated by the wiki
review.notes: On your turn, if you pay 1 grain to the general supply, you can use the same action space that the player to your right has just used on their turn.
